upstream.description: The open alternative to Salesforce, designed for AI.

classification.analysis: Twenty is a large, well-funded open-source CRM (an alternative to Salesforce) built as a TypeScript monorepo with a NestJS/PostgreSQL/Redis backend and a React frontend, letting technical teams define custom objects, fields, and views as code and extend the CRM with a CLI-scaffolded app system. It ships AI agents and chat features built into the CRM itself, GraphQL APIs, workflow automation, and self-hosting via Docker Compose alongside a managed cloud offering. It's aimed at businesses and developers who want a CRM they can version, extend, and self-host rather than rent from a closed SaaS vendor, and is one of the most active and heavily starred open-source CRM projects.

use_cases.title: Self-host an open-source Salesforce alternative for a small business or startup
Scaffold a custom CRM app with defined objects, fields, and views as code
Give a sales team AI agents and chat built directly into their pipeline tool
Track deals, contacts, and companies in a version-controlled, developer-friendly CRM
